root.name: Tarrasch Defense: Rubinstein System
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nc3 c5 4. cxd5 exd5 5. Nf3 Nc6 6. g3

overview: White fianchettoes with 6.g3 against the Tarrasch Defense and after 6...cxd4 7.Nxd4 Nf6 8.Bg2 Be7 9.O-O O-O Black has an isolated queen's pawn against active White pieces. Black gets piece play and the bishop pair-like activity while White aims at the isolani with pressure on d5 and blockades.

white_ideas.idea: Fianchetto with g3 and Bg2 aiming at d5
Blockade and attack the isolated d5 pawn
Trade pieces to emphasise the IQP weakness

black_ideas.idea: Active piece play for the isolated d-pawn

typical_structures.structure: Isolated queen's pawn for Black on d5 with open c- and e-files

character.notes: The Tarrasch is Balanced, where Black has activity at the cost of structure.

gambit.notes: No material is given on purpose in the main line.

character.reason: IQP positions with dynamic compensation, neither Solid nor forcing.

approach.reason: A mainstream branch of the Tarrasch.

plans.reason: Black's IQP and White's fianchetto and blockade.
